title: HelperSSHLaneParams
description: One pty-less EXEC LANE to open on a pooled connection: the destination resolved by the coordinator, the INSTALL whose helper to run there, and the generation that names the build. There is no command and no argv — see `machine` — and the two facts together name exactly one installed binary, which the helper builds the invocation from.

destination.description: What to connect to and what to authenticate as, the same resolved shape `probe` and `open` take.

machine.description: Which installed helper of that machine to run: the install DIRECTORY the coordinator installed into. It is the narrowest honest identity — a lane runs `<dir>/nocx-helper bridge <generation>` and nothing else — and it is the fact both of the coordinator's paths already hold: the install it just completed, and the binary path a reopened session's durable route carries.

generation.description: The content hash the installer wrote (D7, D21). Naming it is what stops a lane from reaching a DIFFERENT generation's sessions, and what lets two generations coexist on one host while an old one still holds somebody's shell.
